system.description: Armor Class: 5 Hit Dice: 9 (L) Move: 90' (30') Attacks: 3 pseudopods Damage: (4d6 + 3d6) X 3 (see below) No. Appearing: 1d3 (2d4) Save As: F9 Morale: 12 Treasure Type: Nil Intelligence: 0 Alignment: Chaotic XP Value: 900 Monster Type: Lowlife (Very Rare). This shapeless monster appears as a puddle or stream of hot molten rock, about 10' x 10'. It lives in or near a volcano or other place of great heat. Although the ooze is native to the Prime Plane, it can freely exist on the elemental plane of Fire.
